label: Marking from the outputs
subgoals: Start the marking at the outputs and kept objects
Walk backward from each marked value to its operands
Sweep every definition that was not marked

label: Transitive dead code
subgoals: Repeat use-count deletion until no definition loses its last use
Get the same result in one pass by marking from outputs
Run DCE after folding to sweep the disconnected logic

label: Dead cycles in hardware
subgoals: Recognize registers that feed only each other as dead
Prefer mark-and-sweep to use counts on cyclic netlists
Declare probes, properties and kept objects as roots
